title: Before the Reading

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Three days the dark month keeps to itself, and the reading goes up when the reading goes up; the pot keeps its crack showing, the stick keeps its notches, and no slate has been read under this roof.
epigraph.attribution: A yard saying of Low Kiln, in the last tending days of Ash

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and thirty-six to three hundred and thirty-eight days, six months and one hundred and fifty-six to one hundred and fifty-eight days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning that register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and thirty-six, thirty-seven and thirty-eight days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, not numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go. The heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell; the told figure stands beside the paid figure with no signature between. Ash's first arithmetic belongs to Ash 10 and stands one morning beyond the close, not brought into a day that has not earned it.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Seventh Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{336}{Ash 7, Seventhday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Seventhday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 246 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; the hand outside the wool comes up for the two hundred and forty-seventh. No recap of Chapter 94. Carry 335 to 336 exact, six months and 156 days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 336 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Ash 4, 5 or 6 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment: the Ash 5 joining of the burned slate to the shut room, the Ash 5 fourth shaping of the well-saying and the Ash 6 turning of Hessa's writing each stand on a place of its own with a finger between and are not joined, spent or promoted. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust two inches from the ear, stiff and leathery in the dry kiln heat, corner standing a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. Composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle. Both true, the second louder, neither wins; the argument is the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with her hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack left showing, turns the dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and lifts no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077 held). The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; the sixth opening at Ash 2 is not revisited as a sign and no seventh is made due. Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid. File open on the towel with every gap gap; staying, early letting-go, handful, thumb's resting and sixth opening five objects on five places with a finger between every pair and none made again. Six arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature, six readings six and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, covered grain, five held objects or his own gaps (T015/T041/T047 carried). Ash 10 (Day 339) three mornings ahead, named as a date only and not brought in. Answer **247**: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed; borrowing no house count, supplying no payer (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Yard Goes Around Again
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 336, no new dated heading: afternoon through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, seven walked-around places, rack end, yard well and flat stone, worked strips, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge and damper, back room from outside, and the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, man with cracked jar in rope sling, woman with a cost-question, woman with basket of kindling, two men mending a strip of fence); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Hessa, no collector, no market, no Cross, no bell. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to wool and river wind, never the basket; seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: clean dark line and finer grey thaw unswept; lowest rack with broken birth-slates; pan's gone ring with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; trough's skin; field's empty place on the worked strips; returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — no eighth likeness, no cause across two, no payer (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair: frost gone off the well's north lip on Bone 3 while the yard looked elsewhere (not a sign); skin on the trough breaking and closing under a pail's knock; silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet (T083/T085 held). Hunts and repairs as directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather: Cold Acre hare answered with the weather and gone toward the clay road with nobody weighing it or opening a slate; cracked jar in a rope sling answered with the pot, and the pot says nothing; a woman's cost-question answered with the weather; a woman with kindling asks what the seventh year will want and two fence-menders say the thaw will be early and late, and Tarn says *Yes, house* to each and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument can find a foot (T077, T036/T076). At the rack end the dressed grain lies turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure; her fingers go in and come out without closing, so no handful is lifted (T077 held). Tarn at the kindling: six where the house can check, seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where a hand could slip it off, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, ear-sentence brought to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight since the dark, Ash in knuckle creases the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring holding light, stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness. The thumb's resting on the uncut seventh of Bone 26 is checked and **not made again** on Ash 7: not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a sixth held change, not a hearing, not a mending, not a rule, no payer standing (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the shed's edge: dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease, not bone-coloured slip; men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and he gives the house no name for them and does not say the room is cold; wheel first — *It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady* — then *You'll do* to a pot; full note known three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withheld from a High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it; bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; burned slate at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, no witness standing, Ash 5 joining held apart and no sixth due (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095 held). Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken 336 days and his tile debt uncalled. Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left, never the Debt Loft, a sound from above and behind only; fire four and a gap, boards four, four and a knot, river water over water — three counts that do not become one. Answer **248** at the very end: small intake let go whole on the river's note; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed.

Domestic texture gathers toward later without becoming a sign: the grey streak at her temple showing pale, coal-black hair pushed back with the burn-wrist, the little-door burn closing on nothing when she carries a cup, the day kept in loaves, glances and unnamed spaces and never in a figure; no new bare place, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause. Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid; file open on the towel with every gap left gap. Six arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature, six readings six and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, covered grain, five held objects or his gaps — the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047 carried). Ash 10 (Day 339) two mornings ahead, named only as a date and not brought in. Answer **249**: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; neither early again nor stayed (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Woman at the Well Keeps Her Count
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 8 through the going of the light and the small hours at the yard well and flat stone, seven walked-around places, rack end, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge and damper, and the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Ilva (once at the well, strip unread, ninth hand), Tarn, Jorra; a woman asking at the well; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man); Garl in objects. No Hessa, no collector, no market, no Cross, no bell. Nothing from Scene 3 crosses into the well as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the three Ash 5/6 movements are kept on separate places. Ilva draws at the yard well with the pail against her knee, rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp as the bucket comes up, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; her hands know the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and have never been soft, and people notice the pail first and the sleeve not at all. A woman asks what the firings of Ash have taken. Ilva's hand goes toward her sleeve and stays; the short strip of notched birch bark, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or any ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Eyes to the asker, mouth opening after both with a half-beat: *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account.* Flat hand once more on the sleeve and back to the pail, nobody turning twice. The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and files it as the **ninth** record-first hand on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth; he files **no tenth**, makes no figure of the slate's nearness, makes her no reader of her own keeping and joins her to none. There is no ownerless saying at this well in this chapter: the Ash 5 fourth shaping stays four shapings and no fifth comes, the Ash 6 turning stays a sighting and not a prophecy, and Ilva is expressly not the speaker of either (T080 held, advanced and not paid). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the arm and the weather, never figures; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between pairs; the dressed grain at the rack end stays covered and unfigured, her fingers going in and coming out without closing (T077 held, T083/T085 held, T009/T013/T092). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, clip-ring holding light, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying; the thumb's resting on the uncut seventh of Bone 26 is checked and **not made again** on Ash 8 (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the wheel-shed: grey dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, men unnamed before first grey, the room not said cold, wheel first and a pot after, the full note known three turns ahead and withheld from a High Kiln master, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, *he's not Vail* sealed, promise ungiven; the burned slate stays at five with the Ash 5 joining held on its own place and no sixth telling, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness and no sixth, the nine stoppings with no tenth (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095 held, T101 held). Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken 337 days and his tile debt uncalled. Three counts that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty; heard bell beside told; six arithmetics locked up the clay road, figure read not figure paid. Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, fold righted without a look, thread left, never the Debt Loft. Answer **250** at the very end: small intake let go whole on the river's note; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed.

Hearth grammar holds the morning before the reading: fire before basket; coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot; *The house will keep it*; intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured; finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread; lips along a two-gapped row unfigured; one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing; dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful; pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). scenes.title: The Crack Left Showing
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 338, Ash 9, the afternoon at the Clay Yard, seven walked-around places, rack end, yard well and flat stone, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge and damper, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man, woman with basket of kindling, two men mending a strip of fence, a woman with a cost-question); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Hessa, no Berr, no green-mouthed woman, no foundling at the close, no collector up or down the clay road, no market, Cross or bell. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T009/T013/T092, T060/T086):** at the going of the light, when Sella lifts the twice-mended pot from the pot board, her thumb goes to the wire where it crosses the crack and stays one breath longer than the lift requires before she lets the weight come on the handle — a small, exact interval held at the place of repair, the hairline of the original break left showing between the old-brass staple and the tighter wire. She says both proverbs to the pot and to the fire and never to a person (*Leave the crack showing. People trust a thing they can see has been handled* and *If it's worth mending it's worth mending twice. The second time is the real one*), improved in the keeping and very likely not as good as the man said them, and repair stays apart from restoration because a restored thing hides the hand that handled it and a mended thing leaves that hand showing. The boy takes the held breath apart by what is there and by what is not — the distance between the thumb's arrival and its moving on, a small interval that buys nothing at two inches of air and is not a gift, for a gift wants a giver and nobody had given — and files it on a place of its own **beside** the staying at the inch, the early letting-go, the handful let fall at the rack end, Tarn's thumb's resting on the uncut seventh and the sixth opening at the kiln mouth, with a finger between every pair: expressly NOT a sixth held object, not a habit, a way, a hearing, a near-full answer, a sign, a mending, a cause, a payer or a rule, and not to be made again. It gathers toward the far-off hand that will one day lay the district's private keepings together, and that hand is still far off and is not his. It is not joined to the charcoal beneath the shelf, Ilva's strip, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, the Ash 6 turned writing, the covered grain or his own gaps; no payer stands under it. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between pairs; hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the arm and the weather, Cold Acre hare answered with the weather and cracked jar sent to a pot that says nothing, a woman with kindling answered by Tarn with *Yes, house* to each of two fence-menders and the late thaw kept because it puts off the paying (T009/T013/T092, T077, T083/T085 held, T098 carried, T036/T076). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, clip-ring holding light, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; the thumb's resting on the uncut seventh of Bone 26 is checked and **not made again** on Ash 7, 8 or 9 (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the shed's edge and damper: grey dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, men unnamed before first grey, wheel first and a pot after, the full note known three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withheld from a High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence so the end of it arrives at the pot, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, *he's not Vail* sealed, the promise neither given nor withdrawn; burned slate at five with the Ash 5 joining held apart and no sixth telling and no seventh made due (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). The whole tray is checked and left as it lay: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell; the told figure beside the paid with no signature; seven a colour and seven a shape with no eighth; nine record-first hands with Hessa's eighth and Ilva's ninth apart and no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; the row at five askings with no witness and expressly no sixth; the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning on separate places with a finger between and between them and every other object, none spent or paid (T101 held, T061/T082, T078, T050/T051 and T033/T034 held, T090 held, T080 held). Garl stays in objects: salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat nobody fills, clean dark line and finer grey unswept, twice-mended pot on the pot board with the hairline of the original break showing between the old-brass staple and the tighter wire, tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with and worse for being uncalled, name unspoken 338 days, no lesson made. Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face, lets her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it goes away, leaves the thread where it lay; says nothing of where they have been, gives the instruction to the fire, wool and pot and never to the basket, and says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I. The widow's mark hangs where it hung and is not touched, because a going of the light and a bed are not openings and six openings in six months are six and not a rule. She goes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw and turns them with the back of a broken pot; the fire answers four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed 338 days. Finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread; lips along a two-gapped row unfigured; one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, fingers going in and coming out without closing (T058/T079/T100, T077). Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand; overhead the boards keep four nails on the near board, four on the next and a thumb-width knot where a fifth might have been driven and was not; through the finger's-width door water over water goes low over lower, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, not numbered among the hearings. Three counts in three places and none rises into another, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands to any. The finding that six are six and not one account stays on a place of its own with no payer and is not laid across the house's not-doings, the dressed grain, the five held objects, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand, the sixth opening, the three Ash 5/6 movements, the new pot-crack resting or his own gaps; the edges come near to touching and the finger goes between, and no doctrine stands up, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T015/T041/T047). **Answer 252** at the very end: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets the intake go on the same low note and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. The note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go was neither early again nor stayed and the hand did not stay; the inch was not a reach, the intake not a breath kept for warmth, the interval not a stopping of the river and the note not his. Filed as answer 252: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the six arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go, the sixth opening, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, Hessa's turned writing, the new pot-crack resting nor his own kept gaps. **Two hundred and fifty-two honest answers** stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither the number nor the small hand-movings that made it stood up and called themselves a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field left as found and an answer entered where nobody can see it; the infant underneath takes none, wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the two registers quarrelling without verdict in the small hours. **338 stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath; six months and 158 days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number with its payer unnamed; the name of the man the salt-stiff coat kept unspoken the same number.** Nothing on Ash 9 was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended. Ash keeps its last tending day without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months is set right; the keeping of the number was the only honest work there was to do, bought nothing at two inches of air, was not for sale, and went on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax. The silt-clouded plate of ice stands on its flat stone out of the path of feet; the file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap; the hand lies back against the fold on answer 252; the runner's writing from Ash 6 is turned toward herself and no figure has come off any slate; and the river's low note goes quiet under the finger's-width door. Ash 10 (Day 339), the dark month's first Account-day and market, stands ONE morning ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; Ash's first arithmetic belongs to its own morning, to go up in Berr's locked box and stand with the six behind one unsigned figure, and the finding that seven are seven and not one account will be kept on a place of its own with no payer. Forward, not closed; no ending, epilogue or doctrine.
